property_summary: For any input, if the caller is the owner, AdjustBetAmounts succeeds on the reference but must revert on the mutant; using a non-owner caller, the mutant can succeed where the reference would revert, violating the invariant that only the true owner can change betLimit.
change_summary: Replace require(msg.sender == owner) with require(msg.sender != owner) so only non-owners can call functions using this modifier, changing who can call OpenToThePublic.
